index_additions:
• A symmetric ideal chain with periodic Lefschetz behavior in positive characteristic
    22 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

    One fixed two-row symmetric ideal chain has periodic weak and strong Lefschetz behavior in positive characteristic, with a classification over every field extension.

    PDF · Zenodo

  • An elementary counterexample to a Nullstellensatz for finite-type link invariants
    12 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

    An explicit principal ideal in the ordinary finite-order link-invariant algebra has a nonempty actual-link zero set whose vanishing ideal strictly exceeds its radical.

    PDF · Zenodo
